items_flat.title_en: Amodei: pace the frontier; Anthropic commits to embedded evaluators
items_flat.title_zh: Amodei：放緩前沿；Anthropic 承諾進駐式第三方評估者
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published the essay “We Must Pace the Frontier,” arguing labs should slow capability gains so alignment and operational safety can keep up. Anthropic unilaterally committed to give third-party evaluators (e.g. METR) permanent employee-like access—desks, badges, laptops, and near-internal risk-team permissions—to verify safety practices, report incidents, and assess alignment of training pipelines, with only narrow redaction rights.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 發表〈We Must Pace the Frontier〉，主張實驗室應放慢能力成長，好讓對齊與營運安全跟上。Anthropic 單方面承諾給予第三方評估者（例如 METR）常駐、近似員工的存取：辦公桌、識別證、公司筆電，以及接近內部風險團隊的權限，以查核安全措施、回報事件並評估訓練管線對齊；僅保留狹窄的安全／法律／保密刪改權。
items_flat.analysis_en: The concrete change is verifiability, not a freeze: Anthropic is opening training pipelines to outsiders in a way no frontier lab has normalized. Whether “pacing” becomes industry practice still depends on governments and rivals matching the access, not only the rhetoric.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 真正改變的是可驗證性，不是停訓：Anthropic 把訓練管線對外部開放，這是前沿實驗室尚未常態化的做法。「放緩」能否成為產業規範，仍取決於政府與對手是否跟上同等存取，而不只是表態。
items_flat.quote: We’ll provide third-party evaluators with permanent, employee-level access to our systems, so that they can verify adherence to our safety measures, report on incidents, and assess models’ alignment during training.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將向第三方評估者提供對系統的永久、員工級存取，以便其查核安全措施是否落實、回報事件，並在訓練過程中評估模型對齊。

items_flat.title_en: Altman: OpenAI will also give independent evaluators employee-like access
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：OpenAI 也將給予獨立評估者近似員工的存取
items_flat.summary_en: Responding to Amodei’s post, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wrote that he agrees the industry needs to pace the frontier and that this has been a primary internal discussion in recent weeks. He called independent evaluators with employee-like access “a great idea” and said OpenAI “will do the same,” with more details to come.
items_flat.summary_zh: 回應 Amodei 貼文，OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 寫道，他同意產業需要放緩前沿，且這是近幾週公司內部的主要討論。他稱給予獨立評估者近似員工的存取是「好主意」，並表示 OpenAI「也會這麼做」，細節稍後公布。
items_flat.analysis_en: An in-kind match from OpenAI turns Anthropic’s unilateral step into a two-lab norm—if the forthcoming details actually include training-time access rather than post-hoc audits. Scope, redaction rights, and which evaluator organizations get in remain unspecified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI 對等跟進，使 Anthropic 的單方面承諾變成兩家實驗室的共同規範——前提是後續細節真的包含訓練期存取，而非事後稽核。範圍、刪改權與哪些評估機構進駐仍未說明。
items_flat.quote: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. … Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same. We'll have more to share soon.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我同意 Dario：我們需要放緩前沿。……承諾讓獨立評估者擁有近似員工的存取是好主意，我們也會這麼做。稍後會公布更多細節。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: “Dario is right” on pacing; later backs competitor peer review
items_flat.title_zh: Musk：「Dario 是對的」；稍後主張由競爭對手互評
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk quoted Amodei’s pacing essay and wrote “Dario is right.” Early on 13 Sep UTC he added that there should be some oversight and that “peer review of AI by competitors is the right way to start.” The posts endorse the diagnosis; they do not commit xAI to embedded evaluators or a training-rate cap.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 轉引 Amodei 放緩論文並寫「Dario 是對的」。9 月 13 日稍早（UTC）他補充應有某種監督，且「由競爭對手對 AI 做同儕審查是正確起點」。這些貼文認同問題診斷，並未承諾 xAI 進駐評估者或訓練速率上限。
items_flat.analysis_en: A public agreement from xAI’s principal is notable because the lab has competed on release cadence. An endorsement plus “competitor peer review” is still not operational access comparable to Anthropic’s desks-and-laptops pledge.
items_flat.analysis_zh: xAI 負責人公開認同值得注意，因為該實驗室一向以發布節奏競爭。表態加上「競爭對手互評」，仍不等同 Anthropic 那種辦公桌與筆電級的營運存取承諾。
items_flat.quote: Dario is right that there should be some oversight. Peer review of AI by competitors is the right way to start this off.
items_flat.quote_zh: Dario 說得對，應該有某種監督。由競爭對手對 AI 做同儕審查，是正確的起步方式。

items_flat.title_en: Grok models begin rolling out in Microsoft Copilot Office apps
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 模型開始進入 Microsoft Copilot 的 Office 應用
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft 365 said Grok models from SpaceXAI are rolling out in Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, starting with a focused release to Microsoft Frontier program customers. CEO Satya Nadella added “More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!” Press reports said the preview excludes Frontier customers in the EU, EFTA and UK, and that admins must opt in.
items_flat.summary_zh: Microsoft 365 表示，SpaceXAI 的 Grok 模型正導入 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 中的 Copilot，先以 Microsoft Frontier 計畫客戶為範圍。執行長 Satya Nadella 寫道「更多模型選擇進入 Copilot。歡迎 Grok！」媒體報導預覽不含歐盟、EFTA 與英國的 Frontier 客戶，且需由管理員選擇加入。
items_flat.analysis_en: Copilot already hosts OpenAI and Anthropic models; adding Grok makes Microsoft the widest enterprise front door among frontier labs. Which Grok checkpoint ships, how tenant data is handled by SpaceXAI as a subprocessor, and when the preview expands remain the operational questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Copilot 已托管 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 模型；加入 Grok 使微軟成為前沿實驗室中最寬的企業入口。實際上線的 Grok 檢查點、租戶資料如何經 SpaceXAI 子處理者處理，以及預覽何時擴大，仍是營運層問題。
items_flat.quote: Grok models from SpaceXAI are rolling out in Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint—starting with a focused release to customers in the Microsoft Frontier program.
items_flat.quote_zh: SpaceXAI 的 Grok 模型正導入 Word、Excel 與 PowerPoint 中的 Copilot——先以 Microsoft Frontier 計畫客戶為聚焦發布。

brief_en: Amodei published “We Must Pace the Frontier” and committed Anthropic to embedded third-party evaluators. Altman matched the evaluator pledge. brief_zh: Amodei 發表〈必須放緩前沿〉並承諾讓第三方評估者進駐 Anthropic。Altman 跟進同等級評估者存取。Musk 稱「Dario 是對的」，稍後主張競爭對手互評。微軟開始向 Frontier 客戶在 Word／Excel／PowerPoint 的 Copilot 導入 Grok。
